tasks.label: Docker: start full stack
tasks.command: test -f .env || cp .env.example .env; docker compose up --build -d && echo 'Open http://localhost:${APP_HOST_PORT:-8000}/docs'

tasks.label: Local: start postgres + redis
tasks.command: test -f .env || cp .env.example .env; docker compose up -d postgres redis

tasks.label: Local: prepare database
tasks.command: uv run python -m app.cli generate-key --out secrets/jwt_private.pem --if-missing && uv run alembic upgrade head && uv run python -m app.cli seed

tasks.label: Lint + types
tasks.command: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy app
